_about: Merged into every model bundle by tools/model_tool.py --extras-json. Numbers measured on the 489 real photos (Nord: leave-one-session-out; Poco/Samsung/iqoo/random never used for fitting). See tests/final_eval.py and tests/exif_scan.py.

checklist: Camera app in Pro / Manual mode (not Auto, Portrait, Night or AI scene).
White balance fixed (not AWB / Auto) — use the same setting every time.
Flash off. HDR, filters and beauty mode off.
Main camera at 1x — no zoom, wide or macro lens. Standard 12 MP photo size.
Phone held landscape; tube and the whole 9-patch card in frame; lightbox closed, lamp on.
